name: Alert
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the necessity of being spiritually alert and watchful, as believers do not know the hour of Christ's return or the time of testing. Jesus commands His followers to watch and pray to avoid falling into temptation, recognizing the weakness of the flesh despite the spirit's willingness. This vigilant readiness is illustrated in His warnings to be prepared for the unexpected coming of the Son of Man, underscoring the need for constant prayer and alertness in the Christian walk.
